about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A glimpse into my academic journey and aspirations
about.paragraph1: I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Biotechnology and am in my final semester, with a strong academic interest in the intersection of microbiology, environmental health, and sustainable biotechnological solutions.
about.paragraph2: My final year research project, which investigates phage-based biocontrol strategies against multidrug-resistant bacterial biofilms, has allowed me to explore biological alternatives to conventional antimicrobial approaches.
about.paragraph3: I am motivated to pursue advanced research training that bridges fundamental microbiology and molecular biology with real-world environmental challenges, particularly those related to water quality, antimicrobial resistance, and public health.
about.beyondScienceText: Interest in visual storytelling, digital design, and creative projects beyond the laboratory.

items.title: Laboratory Intern
items.subtitle: National Institutes of Health (NIH), Islamabad - Nutrition Division (WHO Focal Point for Food Safety)
items.description: Completed internship in food and water chemical and microbiological laboratories. Conducted sample handling and safety testing procedures while maintaining laboratory data and sample records. projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Research and academic projects demonstrating practical application

items.title: Thesis: Isolation of Coliphages and Their Bio-control Application Against Antibiotic-Resistant E.coli Biofilms
description: Isolated and characterized Coliphages from environmental sewage samples targeting antibiotic-resistant E. coli biofilms.

Adopted an interdisciplinary approach to investigate phage-based biological control as a sustainable, eco-friendly alternative to chemical disinfectants, integrating environmental microbiology, public health, and biotechnology to address pollution and antimicrobial resistance (AMR).

items.title: Understanding Vitiligo: Exploring Self-Esteem & Quality of Life
items.description: Conducted data collection through surveys and analyzed relationship between vitiligo and psychological wellbeing.

items.title: Bacterial Isolation from Traditional Fermented Foods
items.description: Prepared fermented food samples and performed serial dilutions. Isolated and identified bacterial species using standard laboratory techniques including morphological characterization.
